verdict.rationale: PlanetScale emits webhook events, including backup.succeeded and backup.failed, and supports Authorization headers on those webhooks. That lets external systems react to platform events automatically. It also supports scheduled backups and recurring agent runs that review Insights and open PRs, which is time-based rather than event-based automation. There is no evidence of a native rule engine where users define conditions and actions; the rule logic must live in an external webhook receiver. Missing for 10: a first-party rule/condition-action builder, a documented full catalog of webhook event types, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
